summary_en: Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 completed a tender offer for JPMC shares ending October 5, 2026, acquiring 9,057,536 shares. Settlement on October 13, 2026 will result in Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 each holding 27.05% voting rights, becoming major shareholders and lead shareholders, while Mutou Enterprises 2 will cease to be lead shareholder.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for JPMC Shares by Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2, and Changes in Major Shareholders, Lead Shareholder and Related Companies
translation_en_brief:
Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 completed a tender offer for ordinary shares of Japan Property Management Center Co., Ltd. (JPMC) on October 5, 2026. The offer, which commenced on August 4, 2026, exceeded the minimum acceptance threshold of 5,049,300 shares, with 9,057,536 shares tendered in total. Settlement is scheduled to begin on October 13, 2026.

Following settlement, Amsterdam1 and Amsterdam2 will each own voting rights representing 27.05% of the total shareholder voting rights on a fully diluted basis (calculated using 16,741,309 shares, derived from 17,725,600 issued shares as of June 30, 2026 less 984,291 treasury shares). Both entities will become major shareholders and lead shareholders of JPMC. Amsterdam1 is wholly owned by Helsinki1, and Amsterdam2 is wholly owned by Helsinki2; both were established on July 13, 2026 and have no prior capital, personnel, or transaction relationships with JPMC.

As a result of the offer completion, Mutou Enterprises 2, the former lead shareholder and a related party, will cease to hold the status of lead shareholder. The offer acquired 9,057,536 shares, representing 54.1% of the outstanding share count excluding treasury shares.
